title: Onramp QuickPulse - SE + ProServices Weekly Sync (2029-01-08)
content:
Date: 2029-01-08
Facilitator: Maya Chen
Attendees: Maya, Diego, Priya, Evan, Leah, Samir (brief)
Duration: 40m standup style
Location: #se-onramp + video

TL;DR:
- Two customers (AtlasHealth, NimbusRetail) progressing to final validation; Atlas needs a last-mile latency fix, Nimbus needs dedicated capacity scheduling confirmed.
- One active blocker from Veridian: private deployment cert rotation caused model reload failures; mitigation in progress.
- Action items: Diego to own Atlas perf tuning, Priya to confirm Dedicated capacity window for Nimbus, Evan to triage cert rotation sequence with infra by EOD Fri.

AGENDA / NOTES:
1) Quick wins / highlights (5m)
- Onboarding checklist automation merged to onramp repo (PR 421).
- New preflight script reduced failed config runs by ~30% in last 2 weeks.
- Customer-facing docs updated for model pinning (Confluence link in artifacts).

2) Customer statuses (round-robin, ~5m each)
- AtlasHealth (owner: Diego) - STATUS: Yellow  Progress: Final integration tests running; anomaly: tail-latency spikes when sequence length >1024. Suspected kernel selection mismatch for 8-bit quantized variant.  Blockers: Need a patch to runtime kernel heuristic; current workaround is to route long requests to higher-memory instances (costly).  Next steps: Diego to run focused traces with tracing hooks and capture kernel selection logs (JIRA-10422). Proposed ETA for patch: 3 business days pending infra PR.

- NimbusRetail (owner: Priya) - STATUS: Green/Amber  Progress: Feature flags and reranker integrated; load tests at 60% of expected peak passed.  Blockers: Reserved Dedicated capacity slot not confirmed for 2029-01-15 ramp (sales-side commitment pending).  Ask: Priya to confirm scheduling with sales and ops by 2029-01-10. If slot not available, fallback to burst pool + lower-qps routing.

- Veridian (owner: Evan) - STATUS: Red  Progress: Private deployment (air-gapped) hit repeated model reload failures after cert rotation on 2029-01-06.  Blockers: Cert rotation process triggers a race in the deployment agent causing model handler to restart before KV cache is persisted. Repro steps attached to JIRA-9321.  Mitigation: Rollback to previous cert config and apply hotfix that introduces a graceful shutdown hook. Evan to coordinate with infra (Samir) and on-call SRE.  ETA for hotfix: 24-48 hours with manual validation.

- MeridianLabs (owner: Leah) - STATUS: Green  Progress: Embeddings pipeline validated; small discrepancy in embedding cosine similarity thresholds observed vs. staging evals.  Blockers: None blocking rollout; follow-up to tune threshold and add regression alert. Leah to create small eval set and hook into Optimize.

3) Cross-customer themes / platform updates (10m)
- Dedicated capacity scheduling: ops announced monthly maintenance window 2029-01-20; any customer ramping near that date should be warned. Priya to include maintenance window in customer comms.
- Runtime hotfix cadence: we have 2 queued patches (kernel heuristic, graceful shutdown). Plan to bundle if low-risk. Discussed canary rollout plan: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback on error rate spike.
- Observability: need token-level cost breakdown for Nimbus runbook. Product/console team to add an ad-hoc dashboard; Samir to request via product-ops ticket.

4) Risks & escalations (5m)
- Risk: If Atlas kernel fix slips >5 business days, customer may request migration to a different model (higher-cost). Impact: revenue + support time. Mitigation: propose temporary query rewriting to cap sequence length at proxy layer.
- Risk: Veridian private deployment instability could trigger security review. Escalation path: inform Security + CSM and prepare formal incident summary if hotfix is delayed beyond 48 hours.

5) Action items (captured)
- Diego Alvarez: Run kernel selection traces for AtlasHealth; attach logs to JIRA-10422; goal 2029-01-11.
- Priya Singh: Confirm Dedicated capacity booking for NimbusRetail for 2029-01-15 ramp and notify ops; goal 2029-01-10.
- Evan Park: Lead hotfix for cert rotation race, coordinate with Samir and SRE; deploy canary and validate; goal 24-48 hours.
- Samir Rao: Open product-ops ticket for token-level cost dashboard; provide ETA; goal 2029-01-12.
- Leah O'Neil: Create compact eval set for MeridianLabs embeddings drift and wire into Optimize alerts; goal 2029-01-12.
- Maya Chen: Draft customer comms for Dedicated maintenance window and distribute to CSMs; goal 2029-01-09.

OPEN QUESTIONS / NOTES TO SELF:
- Can we automate the fallback routing policy when quantized model latency exceeds threshold? (idea: a runtime policy object per-route).
- Need decision: bundle kernel heuristic patch with graceful shutdown or separate rollouts? Pros/cons discussed; leaning toward separate to reduce blast radius.
- Reminder: update onboarding checklist to include cert rotation test for private deployments.

MEETING FOLLOW-UPS / OBSERVABLES:
- Diego to post a short perf graph in #se-onramp when traces completed.
- Evan to file incident postmortem if Veridian not stable after hotfix.
- Weekly cadence: continue same time next Monday (2029-01-15) unless there is an incident call.

ADDITIONAL LINKS / REFERENCES:
- Preflight script PR: github.com/redwood-inference/onramp/PR/421
- Atlas kernel issue: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/JIRA-10422
- Veridian cert incident: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/JIRA-9321
- Canaries & rollout playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/rollouts

Quick note: meeting minutes are purposely terse — use this doc to pick up action items. If you need a full narrative for customer comms, ping Maya and Priya and we'll draft a customer-facing brief.

-- end of notes --
